Why this picker? Built for React apps that need genuine Bikram Sambat date handling — not an English calendar with Nepali labels. 🇳🇵 True BS dates Full Bikram Sambat arithmetic, not faked with offsets. 🔌 Pluggable adapter Swap in your own BS↔AD conversion tables. 🌐 Dual language Toggle English / नेपाली month names and digits. ⛔ Disable rules Disable dates, ranges, before/after bounds, or today. 🎨 Custom styling Theme via CSS variables. Everything overrideable. ♿ Accessible Esc to close, Tab to navigate, ARIA throughout. 📖 Read the docs 🗺️ Roadmap 📋 Changelog bos-nepali-date — MIT · GitHub · npm · Built by Prabin Paudel

Getting started bos-nepali-date is a React component for selecting Bikram Sambat (BS) dates. It ships with a pluggable conversion adapter so you can use the built-in tables or bring your own. Install npm install bos-nepali-date Styles are auto-imported — the component imports its CSS as a side effect. If your bundler strips CSS side effects, import styles explicitly: import 'bos-nepali-date/style' .

Basic usage Wire up the component with a controlled value and an onChange handler. The defaultAdapter includes demo data for 2080–2081 BS. import { useState } from 'react'; import { NepaliDatePicker, defaultAdapter } from 'bos-nepali-date'; function Demo() { const [value, setValue] = useState(null); return ( <NepaliDatePicker value={value} onChange={setValue} adapter={defaultAdapter} /> ); } The onChange callback receives a BsDate object or null (when cleared). // BsDate shape: { year: number, // e.g. 2080 month: number, // 1–12 day: number // 1–32 }

Core props Prop Type Default Description value BsDate | null null Controlled BS date value. onChange (date: BsDate | null) => void — Fired on selection or clear. adapter BsAdapter defaultAdapter Conversion engine for BS↔AD arithmetic. minDate BsDate — Earliest selectable date. maxDate BsDate — Latest selectable date. showLabel boolean false Render a visible label above the input. placeholder string "YYYY-MM-DD (BS)" Placeholder text for the input. className string — Extra class for the root wrapper. Note: minDate and maxDate clamp the selectable range. They combine with disable rules — if any rule matches, the date is not selectable.

Disable options Pass a disable object to control which dates cannot be selected. Property Type Default Description disable.today boolean false Prevent selecting today's date. disable.date BsDate — Disable a single specific date. disable.dates BsDate[] [] Disable a list of dates. disable.before BsDate — Disable all dates before this. disable.after BsDate — Disable all dates after this. // Example: disable today + block weekends manually <NepaliDatePicker disable={{ today: true, dates: [ { year: 2081, month: 1, day: 1 }, { year: 2081, month: 1, day: 15 }, ] }} />

Menu / Display options Pass a menu object to control locale, calendar layout, and visibility of controls. Property Type Default Description menu.lang 'en' | 'ne' 'en' Localize month/day labels and digits. menu.showMonth boolean true Show/hide the month selector dropdown. menu.showYear boolean true Show/hide the year selector dropdown. menu.firstDayOfWeek 0 | 1 0 Start the week on Sunday ( 0 ) or Monday ( 1 ). // Example: Nepali locale with Monday start <NepaliDatePicker menu={{ lang: 'ne', firstDayOfWeek: 1, showMonth: true, showYear: true, }} />
Styling props Prop Type Default Description inputClassName string — Extra class for the input element. inputPattern string | false \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} Native pattern attribute. Set false to remove.

Localization Set menu.lang="ne" to render month names, weekday abbreviations, and calendar digits in Nepali (नेपाली) . The onChange value still returns the date in ASCII BS YYYY-MM-DD format. Option Labels Digits Value format menu.lang="en" (default) English month/day names 0–9 2081-01-15 menu.lang="ne" नेपाली month/day names ०-९ २०८१-०१-१५ (display) / 2081-01-15 (value) Note: The input accepts Nepali digits (०-९) and normalizes them to ASCII automatically.
Styling The picker's base styles are imported automatically from the component. Override these CSS variables to theme the component to match your application.

CSS Variables Variable Default Description --np-font inherits host Font family for picker controls. --np-popover-min-width 280px Minimum calendar popover width. --np-popover-max-width 320px Maximum calendar popover width. /* Example: custom theme */ .np-picker { --np-font: 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; --np-popover-min-width: 300px; --np-popover-max-width: 360px; } Inherited font: The picker inherits the host app's font family. If you need to force a specific font (e.g., a Nepali-capable font), set --np-font on the wrapper or .np-picker class.
Adapter The adapter is the conversion engine that translates between Bikram Sambat (BS) and Gregorian (AD) dates. The library ships with a defaultAdapter and a MemoryBsAdapter for custom year tables.

defaultAdapter Pre-configured with demo data for BS years 2080–2081. Suitable for evaluation and development. Not recommended for production — toAD() and toBS() will throw for dates outside this range.

MemoryBsAdapter Create a custom adapter with your own complete year table. import { MemoryBsAdapter } from 'bos-nepali-date'; const adapter = new MemoryBsAdapter({ anchorBs: { year: 2000, month: 1, day: 1 }, anchorAdIso: '1943-04-14', yearTable: { 2080: [31, 32, 31, 32, 31, 30, 30, 30, 29, 30, 29, 31], 2081: [31, 31, 31, 32, 31, 31, 30, 29, 30, 29, 30, 30], // ... your full table }, }); Note: To use in production, you'll need to provide a complete BS year table (2000–2100 recommended). The published NPM package only includes demo data for 2080–2081.

Creating a custom adapter Implement the BsAdapter interface to provide your own conversion logic: interface BsAdapter { /** Convert a BS date to ISO AD string (YYYY-MM-DD). */ toAD: (date: BsDate) => AdDateIso; /** Convert an ISO AD string to BS date. */ toBS: (date: AdDateIso) => BsDate; /** Add days to a BS date and return a new BS date. */ addDays: (date: BsDate, days: number) => BsDate; /** Difference in days: date2 - date1. */ diffDays: (date1: BsDate, date2: BsDate) => number; /** BS date for today. */ today: () => BsDate; /** Optional supported range for validation. */ range?: { min?: BsDate; max?: BsDate }; }

Accessibility Keyboard: Escape closes the popover, Tab navigates between controls. Click-outside: Clicking outside the popover closes it. ARIA: Month/year toggles expose aria-haspopup / aria-expanded . Calendar days expose disabled state. Input: Numeric mask enforces YYYY-MM-DD format.
